overview.title: Creator overview
overview.subtitle: Estimated is not confirmed, and confirmed is not paid. Every record here is simulated demo data.
overview.accountsFix: Reconnect the account before submitting a post link from it.
overview.submissionsEmpty: You have not submitted a post link yet.
overview.submissionsEmptyHint: Pick a campaign, publish on the platform yourself, then submit the post link here.
overview.claimsEmpty: No claim has been filed yet.

accounts.title: Accounts
accounts.subtitle: Connections are simulated. No social network is contacted and no video is uploaded.
accounts.noUpload: There is no material or video upload anywhere in this prototype. You publish on the platform yourself and then submit the post link.
accounts.emptyHint: Connect the account you publish from, so a post link can be checked against it.
accounts.connectDescription: Choose a platform and write the handle. The demo marks the connection usable without contacting the platform, and stores no credentials.
accounts.handleRequired: Write the handle you publish under.
accounts.connectedToast: The connection is marked usable in the demo.
accounts.reconnectedToast: The connection is usable again in the demo.
accounts.reasonTokenExpired: The stored access token expired, so views can no longer be read for this account.
accounts.reasonPermissionRevoked: The data permission was revoked on the platform, so views can no longer be read for this account.
accounts.reasonUnknown: This connection cannot be used and the source gave no reason.
accounts.nextStepInvalid: Reconnect this account, then submit the post link again.
accounts.replaceNote: Connecting a platform you already have replaces the handle on that same connection and marks it usable again.

submissions.title: Submissions
submissions.subtitle: One entry per accepted post link. An estimate is not a confirmed payment.
submissions.empty: You have not submitted a post link yet.
submissions.emptyHint: Pick a campaign, publish on the platform yourself, then submit the post link here.

submit.title: Submit a post link
submit.subtitle: Publish on the platform first. The demo records a simulated baseline when the link is accepted.
submit.noCampaignDescription: Open a campaign from the catalogue and use its join action, so the rules you join under are the ones shown.
submit.campaignClosedTitle: This campaign is not open for submissions
submit.campaignClosedDescription: Only a published campaign inside its submission window accepts a post link. Nothing was submitted.
submit.rulesVersion: Rules version {version} · your submission keeps this version even if the merchant publishes a change later
submit.connectionPlaceholder: Choose the account you published from
submit.noConnectionTitle: No usable account for this campaign
submit.noConnectionDescription: This campaign accepts posts from the platforms listed in its rules. Connect or reconnect one of those accounts first.
submit.urlHint: Paste the full link to the published post. Shortened share links cannot be resolved by the demo.
submit.publishFirst: The post must already be published on the platform. Nothing is uploaded here.
submit.errorShortLink: This is a shortened share link, which the demo cannot resolve to a post. Open the post on the platform and paste the full post URL.
submit.errorUnsupportedUrl: This link does not point to a single post on a supported platform. Open the post and paste its own URL.
submit.errorMalformedUrl: This is not a usable web address. Paste the full post URL, starting with https://.
submit.errorPlatformMismatch: The link is on a different platform than the account you chose. Choose the matching account, or paste the link from that platform.
submit.errorConnectionInvalid: The chosen account cannot be read right now, so no baseline is recorded and no reward is reserved. Reconnect it first.
submit.errorDuplicate: This post is already submitted to this campaign. Changing the URL for the same post does not create a new entry; open the existing submission instead.
submit.errorCrossCampaign: This post already counts in another campaign. The same platform post cannot earn twice, and it can only be submitted elsewhere after the first campaign ends in a final rejection.
submit.errorCampaignNotOpen: This campaign is not open for submissions now. Nothing was submitted and nothing was reserved.
submit.acceptedToast: The link was accepted and a simulated baseline was recorded.
submit.pendingBaselineToast: The link was accepted. No trusted baseline is available yet, so nothing is metered.

detail.notFoundDescription: It may belong to another creator, or the demo data was reset.
detail.statusPendingBaseline: The link is accepted for checks. Metering starts only once the source gives a trusted baseline.
detail.statusBaselineUnavailable: The source could not give a baseline. We have not fabricated an acceptance time, so nothing is metered yet and no reward is estimated.
detail.statusMetering: The baseline is recorded and the metering window is open. Only qualified views inside the window count.
detail.statusDataUnavailable: The window is open but the source cannot be read right now. The last trusted number and its time are kept.
detail.statusMeteringEnded: The metering window is closed. Later views no longer count; a claim filed in time and any confirmed amount are unaffected.
detail.baselineNote: Views collected before acceptance never count. The reward uses the qualified increment inside the window only.
detail.noAcceptance: No acceptance time exists for this submission. The demo does not invent one.
detail.extensionReasonDataOutage: The source was unreadable while the window and grace were running.
detail.extensionReasonPendingCase: An open claim or appeal blocked a new claim on this post.
detail.extensionNote: An extension gives the published grace again from the moment the block cleared. The metering window is not re-opened and queue times are not back-dated.
detail.retentionReasonPublished: The published retention period after the campaign went live.
detail.retentionReasonClaimDeadline: The claim deadline in force for this post runs later than the published retention.
detail.retentionReasonOpenCases: A submitted claim or appeal is still open, so no end date exists yet.
detail.retentionReasonConfirmedUnpaid: A confirmed amount has not been paid yet, so no end date exists yet.
detail.contentReviewNote: Content review is the merchant's decision about the post. It is a different fact from metering and from any claim, and on its own it is not a payment.
detail.claimsEmpty: No claim has been filed for this post.
detail.resyncNote: If the source stays unreadable, operations can inspect it and run a simulated re-sync; the reason and the result are recorded.
detail.noViewsControl: Views and the simulated clock are moved only from the demo tools panel. This page has no control that adds views.

reward.title: Reward
reward.definition: Qualified views are plays verified against the campaign rules. They are not raw plays, unique people, orders or sales.
reward.estimateNote: Estimated, not confirmed. A confirmed amount needs both the content review and the metering review to pass, and paid is a third, separate fact.
reward.capReached: Capped at {cap} for this post in this campaign. Reaching a view threshold does not raise the cap.
reward.capProgress: {percent}% of the cap for this post
reward.claimableNote: The cap is applied first and rounded down to the sen, then reserved, confirmed and paid amounts for this post are subtracted.
reward.minClaimMet: The new claimable amount reaches the minimum.
reward.minClaimNotMet: The new claimable amount is below the minimum, so it cannot be claimed yet.
reward.thresholdNone: The merchant set no extra view threshold.
reward.thresholdNotMet: The view threshold is not met yet. Both the amount and the view condition must hold.
reward.pendingClaimNotice: One claim per post can be pending. Wait for the open claim to be decided before filing another.
reward.dataUnavailableNote: The source could not be read. The last trusted number and its time are kept; unknown does not mean zero and it is not read as fraud.

claim.confirmDescription: {amount} is the new claimable amount right now. Filing freezes this amount, the metering cutoff and the evidence, and reserves the amount from the reward pool. Reserved is not confirmed and not paid.
claim.reservedDescription: The claim is filed and waiting for review. Reserved money is held for this claim only; it is not confirmed and not paid.
claim.idempotentNotice: That press repeated the same request, so the demo kept the one claim that already exists.
claim.waitlistedDescription: Nothing is reserved and no payment is promised. You are notified when budget recovers, and you have to file again to take a new queue position.

offer.title: Only part of the amount is available
offer.description: You can claim {full} but only {offered} is available. Consent to {offered} now? The remaining {remainder} stays unreserved and is not forfeited.
offer.nothingHeld: Until you consent to this exact amount, nothing is reserved and no queue position is held.
offer.remainderNote: The remainder is judged again as a new claim once this one is decided. It keeps no queue position and no reservation.
offer.staleTitle: This offer has to be made again
offer.staleDescription: The amount or the version behind this offer changed, so your consent is needed on a fresh offer. Nothing was converted automatically.
offer.declinedToast: The offer was declined. Nothing was reserved.
offer.consentedToast: The amount you consented to is reserved for this claim.

claims.title: Claims
claims.subtitle: Your claims, offers waiting for consent and waitlist entries, with the evidence each one froze.
claims.empty: No claim has been filed yet.
claims.emptyHint: A claim is filed from a submission once the new claimable amount reaches the minimum.
claims.waitlistEmpty: You are not on any waitlist.
claims.waitlistNotified: Budget recovered. File again to take a new queue position; the old position is not restored.
claims.waitlistWaiting: No reservation and no payment guarantee while you wait.
claims.resubmitToast: The request was filed again with a new queue time.

claimDetail.notFoundDescription: It may belong to another creator, or the demo data was reset.
claimDetail.partialLabel: Partial consent · {remainder} stays unreserved and is not forfeited
claimDetail.evidenceNote: This evidence is frozen at the moment the claim became valid. Later readings do not change it, and a later rule change is not applied to it.
claimDetail.timelineNote: Content review, metering review, the claim and any payment are four separate facts. None of them implies another.
claimDetail.escalatedDescription: This claim passed the {hours}-hour review target and was escalated to the responsible reviewer. It is still under review; it is not auto-approved.
claimDetail.reservationHeldDescription: {amount} stays reserved while the appeal window runs or an appeal is open. Only operations can finalise the rejection, and only then is the amount released.
claimDetail.releasedDescription: Operations finalised the rejection, so the amount went back to available budget. A new claim has to meet the rules again.

appeal.title: Appeal
appeal.rejectionSourceContent: The content review rejected this claim.
appeal.rejectionSourceMetering: The metering review rejected this claim.
appeal.reasonPlaceholder: Say what should be re-checked and why. This text is recorded with the appeal.
appeal.reasonRequired: Write the reason for the appeal.
appeal.filedToast: The appeal was filed. The reservation stays held.
appeal.windowClosedDescription: The appeal window closed on {deadline}, so a new appeal cannot be filed. Operations still has to finalise the rejection before the reservation is released.
appeal.openDescription: Operations is re-checking the claim. The reservation and the queue position stay as they are while the appeal is open.
appeal.upheldDescription: The claim is back in verification, and your reservation and queue position are kept.
appeal.rejectedDescription: The appeal did not change the decision. Releasing the reservation still requires operations to finalise the rejection.

payments.title: Payments
payments.subtitle: Payment records for your own confirmed claims, with the simulated attempt behind each one.
payments.notWallet: This is a record of your own claims, not a wallet balance. Nothing is held for you here and nothing can be withdrawn.
payments.emptyHint: A record appears once a claim is confirmed, which needs both the content review and the metering review to pass.
payments.attemptsEmpty: No payout attempt has been started.
payments.attemptsEmptyHint: The amount is confirmed and unpaid. Starting a payout is an operations action.
payments.providerAvailableLabel: Funds available in the simulated provider account at
payments.bankUnknownNote: Bank settlement is recorded separately and is unknown here. A successful transfer response does not prove the money arrived.
payments.failedNote: Operations will retry only after confirming the failure. There is no retry control for a creator.
payments.unknownNote: This attempt is being reconciled against the original transaction. No second payment will be made.
payments.processingNote: The payout is processing. The amount stays in its own bucket and is not released.
payments.noPayAgain: A creator has no way to trigger a payment from this page.
